big_case.notes: The questions touch judicial-discipline structure (the Judicial Council's suspension of a circuit judge under 28 U.S.C. 354(a)(2)(A)(i)) and Tucker Act scope, but this pro se collateral suit was dismissed below for want of a money-mandating claim in a nonprecedential summary affirmance, never reached the constitutional question, and was denied at its first conference after a waiver with no noted dissent. Low stakes as a vehicle.
